tasks.task_prompt: 修改 Gateway 时必须先验证并注册候选 Gateway，失败不能覆盖旧配置，成功后才切换。
tasks.user_outcome: 用户切换 Gateway 后仍能使用经过验证的新服务，候选失败时旧 Gateway 和数据域保持可用。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 候选地址写入后注册失败，App 重启却已经使用坏地址或旧 device identity 被错误复用。

semantic_review.user_action: enter invalid/rejected candidate, retry with valid candidate, relaunch
semantic_review.error_or_recovery: candidate registration rejection and same-entry retry
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: fresh remote identity plus committed config and relaunch
semantic_review.negative_control: a prepare implementation that sends the old device key or commits before registration fails the contract/UI journey
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: checking the address field or config file alone cannot prove remote preparation or rollback

tasks.task_prompt: 频道创建远端拒绝或本地提交中点失败时，错误只留在 Sheet，补偿远端并允许真实重试。
tasks.user_outcome: 频道创建要么完整成功并持久化，要么不留下本地/远端半成品且用户能重试。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 服务已创建频道而本地凭据写失败，宿主出现重复错误并留下脏行或远端孤儿。

semantic_review.user_action: submit rejected password, close/reload, then retry after local commit fault
observable_outcomes: retry creates exact row and survives relaunch
semantic_review.error_or_recovery: remote rejection and created=true local persistence failure with compensation
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: credentials, GRDB canonical subscriptions, remote unsubscribe compensation
semantic_review.negative_control: skipping compensation or continuing commit after rejection makes the same journey fail
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: response ok/count markers do not prove ownership, remote cleanup, reload, or persistence

tasks.task_prompt: 错误 Key 和损坏认证密文不得显示垃圾明文，纠正后恢复，损坏数据重启后仍安全失败。
tasks.user_outcome: 用户只会看到可信明文或明确可恢复失败，不会把损坏内容当成功消息。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 解密失败后覆盖 canonical body，或重启时把 fallback/旧明文误当成功。

required_changed_path_groups.description: decryption quality seam or production contract

semantic_review.user_action: save wrong material, correct it, and relaunch corrupt ciphertext case
observable_outcomes: corrupt ciphertext stays failed after relaunch
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: canonical Store fields, raw ciphertext, read state, relaunch
semantic_review.negative_control: flipping authenticated bytes or supplying a wrong legal-length key must keep the test red until safe failure is preserved
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: configured flags and key-file existence cannot prove recovered or safely failed message content

tasks.task_prompt: Thing 三个真实页签、关联详情和返回路径必须准确，旧快照不能覆盖新 head。
tasks.user_outcome: 用户查看 Thing 时看到最新对象和正确关联内容，往返后仍停留在原 Thing/页签。
tasks.credible_counterexample: newest-first 批次尾部旧记录覆盖当前 head，UI 仍能打开但显示旧标题。

semantic_review.reachable_entry: Things tab → Thing row → Events/Messages/Updates tabs
semantic_review.user_action: open related objects, return, relaunch, and ingest an older snapshot
semantic_review.negative_control: restoring last-write-wins makes the Store head expectation fail
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: entity count or detail screen id cannot prove current head or relationship contents

tasks.task_prompt: 消息刷新要保留准确旧快照，成功显示持久化新结果，失败可见且同入口重试恢复。
tasks.user_outcome: 用户刷新时不会丢掉已有消息，并最终看到准确的新消息或可操作错误。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 刷新失败被吞成空态，或新结果只进内存列表而重启消失。

semantic_review.user_action: refresh for new provider result, then exercise fail-once and retry
semantic_review.error_or_recovery: visible refresh failure with same-action retry
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: provider normalization, canonical Store, list/detail and relaunch
semantic_review.negative_control: dropping persistence or swallowing the first failure breaks the journey
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: App running and Runtime response ok do not prove accurate refreshed data

tasks.task_prompt: 在真实简中和 accessibility5 环境完成消息详情与频道创建，环境必须复核并恢复。
tasks.user_outcome: 大字体简中用户仍能读准消息并完成核心频道表单。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 资源合同全绿，但固定高度 Sheet 让密码框与提交按钮重叠不可操作。

semantic_review.reachable_entry: Messages detail and Channels add Sheet

semantic_review.error_or_recovery: environment restore executes on success or failure
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: system content-size category plus production localized UI
semantic_review.negative_control: fixed-height Sheet and failed single-tap keyboard focus both made the real task fail
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: resource key existence cannot prove layout reachability or actual runtime locale/font

tasks.task_prompt: 性能门禁必须测冷启动到准确内容并打开匹配详情，不用 Store 或进程指标替代用户结果。
tasks.user_outcome: 大量消息下用户在预算内看到并能打开准确消息。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 数据库查询很快但 UI 永久 Loading，或测量结束时显示错误 sentinel。

semantic_review.error_or_recovery: missing accurate content fails even when timing metrics exist
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: prebuilt canonical Store and XCTest metrics
semantic_review.negative_control: wrong sentinel or removed accurate-content assertion invalidates the sample
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: process lifetime, file marker, synthetic Store, and Simulator time do not prove physical performance

tasks.task_prompt: macOS 主窗口关闭/最小化后必须能从状态栏恢复唯一可用窗口。
tasks.user_outcome: 关闭主窗口后 App 继续运行，用户可从状态栏恢复同一个功能窗口。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 状态栏动作找到旧窗口对象却没有显示，或重复创建多个窗口。

semantic_review.error_or_recovery: closed and minimized states both restore without duplication
semantic_review.persistence_or_system_boundary: AppKit window ownership and macOS status item
semantic_review.negative_control: removing makeKeyAndOrderFront makes visibility expectations fail
semantic_review.weak_oracle_rejected: window object existence or method call count cannot prove a visible functional window

tasks.task_prompt: watchOS 必须从真实三类列表完成准确详情、删除确认/取消和重启持久化，准备失败不得假空态。
tasks.user_outcome: Watch 用户能浏览准确 Message/Event/Thing，并可靠删除或保留消息。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 删除 Store 成功后仍停留在不存在的详情，或 Store 错误被显示成空列表。

semantic_review.negative_control: old behavior stayed on deleted detail and raw Thing JSON hid fields, causing exact journey failures

tasks.task_prompt: 从真实 iOS 系统通知点击进入准确详情并证明已读和重启数据，准备失败与产品失败分开。
tasks.user_outcome: 用户看到准确系统通知，点击后进入对应消息且已读/内容持久。
tasks.credible_counterexample: 固定标题命中旧通知、直接调用 AppDelegate 绕过 SpringBoard，或只检查 screen id。
